required: acquisition receipt fragment byte count equals file byte count
acquisition receipt fragment SHA-256 equals completed QC receipt fragment SHA-256
pseudobulk receipt carries the same fragment SHA-256
fragment_custody.rule: Receipt-to-receipt cryptographic binding is sufficient; do not re-hash the 63.6 GB file on every downstream producer if the authenticated acquisition and full-QC receipts are bound to the same digest.

consensus_auxiliary_inputs.rule: Paths are locators, not identities. The region-universe receipt must bind bytes for every input capable of changing interval boundaries or exclusions.

fail_closed: missing digest field in a receipt that is presented as authoritative
blacklist record count differs from the pinned resource after decompression
